t: Forge Steel double cup suction lifter features a robust ABS body and twin 116mm rubber pads to generate a powerful grip, providing a secure, manual solution for handling large, non-porous materials. Ideal for tradespeople involved in glazing, carpentry, and tiling. The lever-operated tool can lift up to 70kg, simplifying the safe transportation and positioning of heavy items such as large panes of glass, sheet metal, and polished stone. Includes a fixed handle to ensure precise control and stability during operation.
b: Effective For Glass, Doors, Windows & Sheet Metal
